alerts.headline: 1.7% of the 716 customers first billed by Faizan K. at PAT-01 came back and billed again, against 5.2% for colleagues' customers first billed in the same months.
alerts.cause: Faizan K. is behind colleagues in 6 of the 6 three-month periods compared, so this is a pattern and not one slow season or a late joining date. Among customers first billed since 15 Apr 2025, the ones most like today's new customers, it is 1.1% against 3.6%; rupees at stake use these two figures. arithmetic.worked: (3.6% − 1.1%) × 5.7 new customers a week × ₹11,484 = ₹1,600 a week

data_issues.title: C99999999 is a placeholder mobile number, not a customer
data_issues.detail: Customer id C99999999 is on 1,708 bills at 19 different stores between 1 Nov 2024 and 10 Oct 2026. One person cannot bill that often or in that many stores (the rule: twenty-five or more bills, or six or more stores), so this is a number keyed in when the customer gave none.
data_issues.handling: Those bills still count as bills for conversion and for basket size, but they cannot be followed for repeat: the id is left out of every return-rate figure, and no alert is raised from it.

data_issues.title: PAT-03: door counter shows no walk-ins on days with bills
data_issues.detail: Footfall is zero or blank on 6 days between 5 Oct 2026 and 10 Oct 2026, and 14 bills were made on those days. A bill needs a walk-in, so the footfall count is wrong, not the sales.
data_issues.handling: These days are left out of both bills and walk-ins wherever conversion is worked out, and no alert is raised from them. In the current window 6 days are unusable and 22 are usable. That is more than a fifth of the window, so the conversion of PAT-03 is not judged this week.
